title: MILO Marathon Subic Leg 2026 Review: RUNRIO's Series Hits the Freeport
seo_title: MILO Marathon Subic Leg 2026 Review | Zambales Philippines
meta_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 Subic (Zambales) Leg: October 18 in Subic. 21K to 3K from RUNRIO with registration open — the Philippines' premier series at the freeport.
dek: Set for 18 October 2026 in Subic, Zambales, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg offers four distances with registration open. The Philippines' premier running series at one of the country's best running venues.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Subic Leg brings RUNRIO's gold-standard race production to Subic Bay Freeport — one of the Philippines' premier running environments with wide, well-maintained roads and minimal traffic. Four distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 3K) with registration open. October in Zambales is the transition into the dry season. For runners wanting a MILO series qualifier at a venue that's genuinely fast and well-suited to road racing, Subic is one of the strongest leg venues on the circuit.

sections.heading: Subic: The Runner's Freeport
paragraphs: Subic Bay Freeport's wide boulevards, legacy of the former US naval base, provide one of the Philippines' best road-running environments — flat, traffic-light, and well-maintained. [1] A RUNRIO MILO qualifier here means professional timing, well-stocked aid stations, and a proven race-day operation.

paragraphs: A RUNRIO MILO qualifier at Subic — one of the Philippines' best-venue, best-produced combinations. Registration open. 18 October 2026. [1]
